carryOn.reason: Dry spices and seasonings are allowed in carry-on. If spices are in powder form and over 12 oz, place them in a bin for separate screening.

checkedBag.reason: Spices and seasonings are allowed in checked baggage.

tsa.pageTitle: Can I bring spices on a plane?

travelTips: Dry spices and seasonings are allowed in carry-on. If spices are in powder form and over 12 oz, place them in a bin for separate screening.

faq.question: Is spices allowed in carry-on bags?
faq.answer: Spices is allowed in carry-on luggage. Dry spices and seasonings are allowed in carry-on. If spices are in powder form and over 12 oz, place them in a bin for separate screening.

faq.question: Can you pack spices in checked baggage?
faq.answer: Yes, Spices is allowed in checked bags. Spices and seasonings are allowed in checked baggage.

faq.question: Can you bring spices and seasonings on a plane?
faq.answer: Yes! Dry spices and seasonings are allowed in carry-on and checked bags. Powder containers over 12 oz (350 ml) in carry-on may undergo additional X-ray screening.
